newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,274 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,274 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,274 contracts compared with 886 overnight Wednesday.
There were 108 wheat, 311 corn, 636 soybean, 114 soymeal, 90 soyoil, two oat, two corn calls, nine soybean calls and two soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1-1/4 to 4-1/4 cents lower, corn was 1-1/4 to 1-3/4 cents lower and soybeans were 1/2 to 2-1/4 cents lower.
